name: Phuket/ Phuket International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 09/27, 45 m wide; 3,000 m long from runway 09 and 3,100 m from runway 27
runway.quote: RWY 09: length 3000, width 45; RWY 27: length 3100, width 45

handling.v: Siam Land Private Jet Terminal (private aircraft only); Siam Land Flying is listed as handling agent for private aircraft
handling.quote: Siam Land Private Jet Terminal (Private Aircraft only)

slots.v: private jets must fly to the time slot approved by the Slot Coordination Committee, within 2 hours early or late
slots.quote: shall commence the flight in accordance with the approved time slot by the Slot Coordination Committee. If the flight is delay or arrive early, it should not more than 2 hours.

ppr.v: private jets need permission from the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand and a ground handling agent, and the airport must be told at least 3 workdays before arrival
ppr.quote: Aircraft owner/operator or PIC shall inform The Airports of Thailand Public Company Limited at least three (3) workdays before the arrival aircraft

max_aircraft.v: stands 51 to 54 and Apron E (remote, overnight parking) are for private aircraft only

notes: Read from the eAIP edition effective 14 May 2026. Newer AIRAC editions (6 Aug 2026, 3 Sep 2026) could not be opened; recheck. Runway 27 has a 100 m displaced area, which is why the lengths differ by direction. No engine start-up is allowed on Apron E. No night restriction was found in the sections read (AD 2.23 onward was not fully read). IATA code is not given in the AIP. The 'max_aircraft' field holds stand allocation only; the AIP gives no weight limit for business aviation.
